LESSON: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when they prayed to God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus
2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus
   In simple words: practise until you can retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives
   In simple words: practise until you can recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus in the examples.
2. Explain Healing of Blind Bartimaeus to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.
4. Show that you can: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Healing of Blind Bartimaeus important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song about the healing power of God,
2. Read Mark 10:46-52 and retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
3. Role-play the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
4. Record the role play using a digital device,
5. Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing experiences is enhanced as learners share an incident when they prayed to God for healing.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus
2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
